title: Coupons and Discounts: Codes, Automatic Offers and Buy X Get Y | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A discount can win a first order or clear a shelf, if it stops when you want it to. CrestApps coupons give you codes buyers type, automatic discounts that apply by themselves, and buy X get Y offers, each with dates, usage limits, minimums and combining rules, plus discount links and unique single-use codes.

In this video:
• Why coupons, and how codes, automatic discounts and limits fit together
• Creating a code: percentage, usage limit, uses per customer and an end date
• Fixed amounts, minimums and what a coupon combines with
• Automatic discounts and buy X get Y
• Discount links and generating unique codes as a CSV
• What the buyer sees at checkout, including codes that cannot be combined
• Finding coupons and following their recent uses
